title: Anna Paulina Luna's MK Ultra hearing
summary: Michael Shurmer tells of Anna Paulina Luna's MK Ultra hearing, about 2026 at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Like he's friends with um uh Anna Pina Luna. Okay. She seems to be an insider. She just yesterday had a big u congressional hearing on MK Ultra.

plain: A researcher named Michael Shurmer, debating on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2026, says that a person they are discussing is friends with Anna Paulina Luna, a member of the US Congress who he says seems to be an insider. He adds that just the day before, she had held a big congressional hearing on MK Ultra, a Cold War CIA programme of mind-control experiments. He mentions it as a sign of how close such insiders are to official efforts to open up secret files.
